findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 16 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 49 questions numbered 1-49; by section: 16.1 5, 16.2 5, 16.3 3, 16.4 12, 16.5 11, 16.6 7, 16.7 6.
